== Description ==

[[Taylor Gosiaco]] (left, navy button-down and glasses) playing [[Mark Billings]] (right, patterned cardigan and ponytail), with [[Spencer Gosiaco]] (standing behind, black Mariners cap and black jacket) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025; background players unlabeled.
